lines.en: I don't walk. I hang beneath a leaf.
When the wind blows, I sway gently.

lines.zh: 我把自己固定在叶脉上
lines.en: I've fixed myself to the leaf vein.
A ring of pattern on my brown shell.
The leaf sways and I sway with it.
I can't move, and needn't.
The silk holds me steady.
The wood is dark. Good for hiding.
Rain taps my shell with a muffled sound.
Inside, I'm slowly changing.

lines.zh: 外面的世界隔着一层壳
lines.en: The world is one shell away.

lines.zh: 我被吹得倾斜，又弹回来
lines.en: I tilt in the wind and swing back.
The leaf stalk bends under me.

lines.zh: 我不需要找地方，地方已定
lines.en: I needn't seek a place. It's set.
A bug crawls past my shell's edge.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，这就是我的走
lines.en: Motionless is how I travel.
Quiet inside, only a heartbeat.
I'm waiting for my wings to finish.
The shell is starting to feel tight.
Light comes through the leaf, green.
Someone below is looking up at me.

lines.zh: 我不打算解释我在做什么
lines.en: I don't plan to explain what I'm doing.
My silk threads glint in the wind.
I can sense the sky changing.
Still some time to go.

lines.zh: 壳上的纹一天比一天深
lines.en: The pattern deepens day by day.
I'm in no hurry to leave.
I've listened to this forest wind a long while.
I can only look. I can't turn.
You're standing very close to this tree.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了我的叶子
lines.en: Your shadow covers my leaf.
Are you after silk? That would kill me.

lines.zh: 我在这里，你未必看得见
lines.en: I'm here, though you may not see me.
Don't shake this tree. I'm on it.

lines.zh: 壳里的眼睛还没完全睁开
lines.en: The eyes inside aren't fully open.

lines.zh: 你举起手了，我认得这姿势
lines.en: You raised a hand. I know that gesture.
Wait a while and I'll fly.
Touching me now is too soon.
A small dent in my shell.
I swing hard; the silk creaks.
Inside, I curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 有液体从裂缝里渗出来
lines.en: Fluid seeps from a crack.
That cost me a piece of myself.
I don't cry out. I have no voice.
The leaf is knocked over.
My shell isn't finished growing.
You'll destroy a moth.
One more and I'm truly broken.
I don't eat. I'm sleeping.

lines.zh: 你把花举到树下，我闻不到
lines.en: You hold a flower up. I can't smell it.
I need no nectar in this stage.
Ask me when the wings are out.
This shell blocks the scent.
Put the flower down. I'll remember.
White flowers are best, but later.

lines.zh: 现在我只有一件事要做
lines.en: Right now I have only one thing to do.
Don't trade a flower for my shell.
I heard. I'm not moving.

lines.zh: 有人碰到壳，我晃了几圈
lines.en: Someone touched my shell and I spun.
My silk pulled taut but held.
I bump the leaf face, lightly.
Don't push, I'll fall.
That left my shell hanging crooked.

lines.zh: 我慢慢荡回来，恢复原位
lines.en: I swing slowly back into place.
The leaf dips under my weight.
Your head bumped me.
I can't make a sound. I can only sway.
Don't touch me a second time.
At this stage I only want to emerge.
Wait until the wings unfold.

lines.zh: 白色的花会引来我的同类
lines.en: White flowers will draw my kind.
We'll meet at night.

lines.zh: 那时我只有几天的寿命
lines.en: Then I'll have only days to live.
So I won't waste them.
Your shell is nearly splitting too.
We'll hang here and wait together.
When the wind's strong, come closer.
There'll be two big moths in this wood.
I can pick nothing up.
The silk hangs from the leaf.

lines.zh: 你放下什么，我也拿不了
lines.en: Whatever you set down, I can't take.
I don't need such things.
Wind, though, could carry me off.
I'm waiting, not collecting.

lines.zh: 壳会自己裂开，不用工具
lines.en: The shell opens itself. No tools.
Put your things away.
This leaf is all I have.
Don't leave things under me.
I have no attack, only waiting.
You come near and I can't flee.
I feel the tree tremble.

lines.zh: 你在算我什么时候破壳
lines.en: You're timing when I'll break out.
This shell won't take many blows.
I draw myself tighter inside.
If only the wind would come.
The one below is reaching up.

lines.zh: 我被丝粘在叶上，只能看。
lines.en: The silk holds me to the leaf; I can only watch.
But I will last until I emerge.

lines.zh: 我听见你的呼吸在下面
lines.en: I hear your breathing below.
Your hand rests on the stalk.
One hard pull and I fall.

lines.zh: 我尽量把自己贴紧叶面
lines.en: I press myself flat to the leaf.
The light shifts. I know the hour.
You look up and I'm there.
This one leaf won't save me.
Then let's see who moves first.
I wait for the shell to split.

lines.zh: 那一刻，我就不是现在这样
lines.en: Then I won't be what I am now.
I have no hands to strike with.
I can only sway and rustle the leaf.
My shell grazes your forehead.

lines.zh: 这一下是风推的，不是我
lines.en: The wind pushed that, not me.
You knocked me into the air.

lines.zh: 我在下落时碰到你的肩
lines.en: Falling, I glance off your shoulder.
The shell is hard, but it's only a shell.
I have no venom and don't bite.
That little knock hardly counts as an attack.
You want silk, not a fight.

lines.zh: 一只毛虫在叶上结了我
lines.en: A caterpillar spun me on a leaf.
I hang under a leaf in the forest.
I'm an Atlas cocoon, and large.
A brown shell no one can move.
I wait here to emerge.
Silk ties me to the vein.
It's raining. I can take it.
At night, a moth will come out.
I don't eat and I don't move.
This leaf is mine now.
The heat snaps my silk first.
I hit the ground and my shell splits.
Water soaks the silk and I sink.

lines.zh: 气浪把我从叶上撕下来
lines.en: The blast tears me off the leaf.
An arrow pins into my shell.
That force reaches inside my shell.

lines.zh: 我靠存的养分，快用完了
lines.en: My stored reserves are running out.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，壳抖了一下
lines.en: Lightning hits the tree and my shell jolts.
The silk snaps and I fall into nothing.
